Subject: HelioSystems security portal onboarding — evidence & ephemeral creds

Hi Rafael,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're ready to get HelioSystems set up in our vendor portal. A few details up front so we can plan the evidence handoff: 

- Portal: Whistic (we'll create a vendor record once we get a contact)
- Primary asks: SIG/CAIQ mapping, sample SOC2 artifacts (system descriptions, logging screenshots), and a mapping of who owns S3 evidence buckets for temporary uploads
- File transfer: Helio prefers short-lived presigned URLs to avoid long-term credentials; would love your recommended approach

I've attached a small CAIQ fragment showing the sections our security team would prioritize (Helio_CAIQ_fragment.xlsx).

Can you put together a short-ish intake plan (attachments, preferred filenames, TTL for presigned URLs) and loop in whoever owns evidence ingestion? We're aiming for a two-week window.

HelioSystems

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Aug 2028 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HelioSystems security portal onboarding — evidence & ephemeral creds

Hi Linda — great to hear you're ready. Short plan below and I've attached our onboarding checklist to make it explicit.

Quick intake plan (high level):
1) Portal record: We'll create a Whistic vendor profile and invite your security contact. Please confirm the org email to list (linda@helio.example.com is fine).
2) Evidence bundle: Preferred filename pattern: HELIO_<DOCTYPE>_<YYYYMMDD>.pdf (e.g., HELIO_SOC2_SysDesc_20280802.pdf)
3) Transfer method: We can do one of two flows —
   - Presigned upload URLs (recommended): short TTL (24 hours) for each artifact; we generate and send links via a secure ticket.
   - Temporary SFTP account: 7-day expiry, audited with rotation — useful for larger bundles.
4) SIG/CAIQ mapping: We'll provide a mapping template (SIG rows -> Redwood evidence filenames).
5) SOC2 samples: redacted system descriptions + logging screenshots + PCI/other scoping notes where relevant.

Target cadence: 2-week onboarding. First milestone: vendor record created + one presigned link test by EOD Fri.

Attaching: redwood_onboarding_checklist.pdf (contains doc list and example filenames).

I'll loop in Jonas (portal tooling) and Irene (security intake + evidence ownership) to handle mapping and presigned URL ops.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
rachel@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

Thanks Rafael — that all sounds good. A couple clarifications from our side: 

- Confirmed: we will accept presigned URLs; 24-hour TTL works. For larger files (over 150MB) we may request SFTP.
- SOC2 artifacts: we've redacted a copy of our system description and a sample logging dashboard export; I'll upload the CAIQ fragment now so you can see the expected mapping.
- Whistic contact: I'm adding support@whistic.com to help with the portal invite; please create the vendor record under "HelioSystems, Inc."

Next steps from Helio:
- I'll upload the CAIQ spreadsheet and a small sample log export (zipped) to your presigned test link once you send it.
- Our compliance reviewer will want an explicit list of what you consider PI vs non-PI in the SOC2 screenshots; that can be a short CSV.

On the attestation front, are you able to provide a short note on where Redwood hosts evidence (S3 region, KMS keyholder)? We can redact specifics for the portal but need the mapping.

Thanks,
Linda
